correctness.rationale: The submitted gcd theorem survives, but the original RESULT reversed the standard Kohn polar indexing while calling it standard: Kohn has delta_0=deg X=e^n. The repaired RESULT uses delta_i=binom(n+1,i)e^(n-i)(e-1)^i, reverses only the ordering of the same vector, and reindexes the valuation proof by a_k=delta_{n+1-k}. For p not dividing e, the endpoint a_N has valuation zero. For p dividing e, nu_p(binomial(N,k)) is at least nu_p(N)-nu_p(k), and nu_p(k)<=k-1<=(k-1)nu_p(e), so every term has valuation at least nu_p(N), attained at k=1. The corrected Chern-sum indexing was independently regression-checked by the supplied repaired verifier.
risks: The finite checker is corroboration only; the uniform gcd statement rests on the valuation proof.
